# llms.txt

StealthEye Agent OS is a public-visible, locked-down build repo for a high-autonomy agent operating system: Mission OS, mission-scoped authority, durable workers, MCP/custom apps, signed manifests, Guard decisions, receipts, evals, and compliance-ready evidence for authorized online tasks beyond code automation. Build 2 adds `@stealtheye/agent-registry`. Build 3 adds `@stealtheye/guard`. Build 4 adds `@stealtheye/mission-os` for StealthEye Mission Language, normalized missions, authority envelopes, plans, status snapshots, receipt refs, Guard capability-token templates, requested-action generation, fixtures, and Vitest eval-style tests.

## Orient quickly

1. Read `AGENTS.md` for operational rules, commands, and hard stops.
2. Read `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/AUTONOMY_MODEL.md`, `docs/MISSION_OS.md`, `docs/AGENT_REGISTRY.md`, `docs/CUSTOM_APPS.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md`, `docs/WORKFLOWS.md`, `docs/EVALS.md`, and `docs/RECEIPTS.md`.
3. Inspect `packages/agent-registry/src/*`, `packages/guard/src/*`, `packages/mission-os/src/*`, and package tests for Build 2-4 implementation.
4. Treat issue #1 as canonical planning context.
5. Keep public/private boundaries intact. Never add secrets, production endpoints, customer data, private OAuth clients, cloud/account details, production tokens, money movement, production deploy automation, or sensitive runbooks.

## Core app suite

Mission OS, CodeOps, CI Repair, BrowserOps, Worker Fleet, Guard, Secrets Broker, Memory Graph, Tool Router, Evals, StagingOps, InfraOps, Observability, ProductOps, InboxOps, CustomerOps, ResearchOps, CommerceOps, Agent Registry, Semantic Firewall, Workflow Compiler, Agent Arena.

## Autonomy boundary

Agents may act broadly inside approved mission envelopes. Mission OS structures that authority; Guard must deny or escalate destructive deletion, raw secrets, money movement, production deployment/data mutation, production-impacting migrations, auth/security-critical changes, protected branch mutation, force push/history rewrite, CI/test weakening, material external sends, legal commitments, and platform-required confirmations.

## Verification commands

```bash
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
```
